name: Roofline-guided stage-wise optimization
definition: A methodology that uses stage-wise performance characterization to match optimization strategies to the dominant hardware constraints of the baseline pipeline, by reducing intermediate data movement in the front end and reducing arithmetic overhead in rasterization.
summary: Roofline-guided stage-wise optimization matches rendering stages to hardware bottlenecks using the Roofline model, applying memory-centric fixes to bandwidth-bound phases and compute-centric fixes to compute-bound phases.
